description.value: Hunnybee Bruncheonette is a counter-service cafe and brunch spot in Vancouver's Strathcona neighbourhood, sitting on the corner of Gore Avenue and Union Street. It serves brunch classics — shakshuka, ricotta pancakes, eggs benny variations, and fresh-pressed juice — alongside espresso drinks and cocktails. The same address hosts a sibling evening restaurant, Thank You Pizza, making it a versatile stop on a city ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully fetched and corroborates the OSM address (789 Gore Avenue, Vancouver, BC V6A 2Z9). The site identifies the business as a counter-service bruncheonette, confirms the email hey@hunnybee.ca, and provides a detailed menu — no bike-specific amenities (rack, Wi-Fi, pump, charging) are mentioned anywhere. GF is explicitly flagged on the menu for Hash Benedict, and multiple vegetarian-friendly dishes are present.
concerns: No phone number in OSM or on website; email (hey@hunnybee.ca) is the only direct contact.
OSM address omits postal code; website gives full address 789 Gore Avenue, Vancouver, BC V6A 2Z9 — updated in address field.
Bike-specific amenities (rack, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are entirely unconfirmed; on-site visit would be needed to verify.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active counter-service cafe in a central Vancouver neighbourhood with a strong brunch menu and verified address; a practical and welcoming stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The same physical address hosts a separate evening restaurant, Thank You Pizza (5 pm–9:30 pm Wed–Sat). A related cafe, The Birds & The Beets, operates at 55 Powell Street in Gastown.

Takeout.detail: Described as a counter-service bruncheonette; walk-in, no-reservation model implies takeout is available

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly marks Hash Benedict as GF; multiple vegetarian dishes present (Egg & Avocado Toast, Shakshuka, Sweet Ricotta Pancakes, Yogurt & Granola)

wow_evidence: counter-service cafe and brunch spot in Vancouver's Strathcona neighbourhood
